source_dataset.agency: U.S. DOT / Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration
source_dataset.name: Company Census File

eligibility_definition.duplicate_behavior: Census duplicate dot_number rejects the input; MOTUS one-to-many rows are all evaluated and at least one must satisfy the complete authority conjunction.

issue_6_determinations.semantic_binding_separate_limitation: The candidate's selected predicate meanings are bound, but the schema object belonging to the required complete-frame acquisition is absent.

blockers: The exact complete Company Census frame is absent, so its digest, row count, acquisition window, ordering, and content cannot be verified.
The complete-frame acquisition manifest, acquisition-bound schema object, and successful real-frame audit artifact are absent.
The only documented Census acquisition prefix is incomplete and is not present in this checkout; the live mutable endpoint cannot reconstruct its historical identity.
The preregistered temporal contract therefore prohibits the Census/MOTUS join and the candidate rule cannot be frozen or executed.
known_limitations: The bounded 100-row Census cohort is non-random, non-representative, and not a substitute for the complete frame.
The available MOTUS complete frame is not independently sufficient to construct the eligible carrier frame.
No exclusion counts, eligible row count, eligible-frame digest, or repeat-run comparison exists because fail-closed validation stops before transformation.
